components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The stored value is a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits and is returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a household).
            Write-only hint used only on create; it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year, e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners who knowingly share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing owner at that address; absent
                otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1E7B4D6058'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last
                name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier, 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an
                email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

The rule: when creating an owner, if **more than 80** owners have already been registered for that day, the response's `bulkSignupWarning` is `true`; otherwise `false`. The value is read back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, so it's a creation-time snapshot persisted on the owner — mirroring the existing `namesakeCount` precedent.

Changes made:

1. **`BulkSignupWarningEvaluator`** (new `rest` component, alongside `NamesakeCounter`/`CustomerCodeGenerator`) — a single-responsibility unit that holds the `BULK_SIGNUP_THRESHOLD = 80` constant and decides `isBulkSignup(ownersAlreadyRegistered)`.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — injected the evaluator and reused the day's owner count that was already being fetched for the daily-limit check (no duplicate query), setting `owner.setBulkSignupWarning(...)` from it.

3. **`Owner` entity** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` field (`bulk_signup_warning` column), getter/setter, and `toString` entry.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct auto-maps it in both directions.

5. **Schema SQL** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `bulk_signup_warning` column.

The daily-limit rule and the warning now share the same accumulation path (one `countOwnersByRegistrationDate` call). The acceptance test (`bulkSignupWarning` false on a fresh create, read back via GET) and the full suite pass with `BUILD SUCCESS`.
